unit.why: A single memorate, given in two quoted versions, about the author's father: praying as rabbi of Sieniawa in the room where R. Shmelke and R. Elimelech had prayed, he was seized by fear and then by love, which he credited to the holiness they left in the place.

stories.summary_en: The author's father, as rabbi of Sieniawa, prayed in the room once used by R. Shmelke of Nikolsburg and R. Elimelech. One Sabbath eve he was suddenly seized by awe and fear that lasted a week, and the next Sabbath by a fiery love, which he attributed to the blessing R. Shmelke left in that place.

quotes: נפל עליו פתאום בליל ש״ק אימה ופחד גדול
tags.why: sudden fear seizes him for a week

quotes: זכה מוזל״ה לבחי׳ יראה ופחד עד מלוא שבועה
tags.why: religious awe (yirah) as a spiritual state

quotes: זכה לבחי׳ אהבה רשפי׳ כשפי אש
tags.why: a burning love and longing, akin to hitlahavut
both experiences begin on Sabbath eve

quotes: והתפלל בחדר שהתפלל בו הגה״ק מהר״ש שמעלקא
והיה מתפלל בחדר שהתפלל בו מהר״ש
tags.why: the setting is his place of prayer
the subject is the narrating tsaddik's own father

quotes: וכעין ששמעתי מפי מוזל״ה סיפר לי
tags.why: the father tells his son about his experience

quotes: וידעתי כי מתת אלהים הוא מכת קדושת המקום
tags.why: a supernatural spiritual gift transmitted through the holy place
